'''''Chrysanthellum''''' is a [[genus]] of flowering plants in the [[Asteraceae|aster family]].<ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/235805#page/474/mode/1up Richard, Louis Claude Marie in Persoon, Christiaan Hendrik. 1807. Synopsis plantarum, seu Enchiridium botanicum, complectens enumerationem systematicam specierum hucusque cognitarum 2: 471] in Latin</ref><ref>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40008398 Tropicos, ''Chrysanthellum'' Rich.]</ref>

==Species==
As of 1988;<ref name=h/><ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/12983785#page/8/mode/1up Turner, Billie Lee. 1988. Taxonomic Study of Chrysanthellum (Asteraceae:Coreopsideae). Phytologia 64:418-444.]</ref>
* ''[[Chrysanthellum americanum]]'' <small>(L.) Vatke</small> - [[Central America]], [[West Indies]], [[Chiapas]]; naturalized in parts of [[Asia]], [[Africa]], [[South America]]
* ''[[Chrysanthellum filiforme]]'' <small>McVaugh</small>	- [[Michoacán]]
* ''[[Chrysanthellum indicum]]'' <small>DC.</small>
* ''[[Chrysanthellum integrifolium]]'' <small>Steetz</small> - [[Central America]], southern [[Mexico]]
* ''[[Chrysanthellum involutum]]'' <small>Paul G.Wilson</small>	- [[Guerrero]], [[México State]]
* ''[[Chrysanthellum keilii]]'' <small>B.L.Turner</small> - [[Michoacán]]
* ''[[Chrysanthellum michoacanum]]'' <small>B.L.Turner</small> - [[Michoacán]]
* ''[[Chrysanthellum perennans]]'' <small>B.L.Turner</small>	- [[Oaxaca]]
* ''[[Chrysanthellum pilzii]]'' <small>Strother</small> - [[Oaxaca]]
* ''[[Chrysanthellum pusillum]]'' <small>Hook.f.</small> - [[Galápagos]]
* ''[[Chrysanthellum tamaulipense]]'' <small>B.L.Turner</small> - [[Tamaulipas]]
